phase: Accounting Spine / F6 selective reopen — OECD counterpart Stage 2
purpose: Preregister a retained-source value/reconciliation and exact-rank gate after the official OECD quarterly from-whom-to-whom artifact was found to satisfy the declared F6 reopen condition by publishing total F6 and F61-F66 by reporting/counterpart sector for Romania. Presence alone cannot materialize cells.

source.lineage: OECD-ECB quarterly financial-accounts collection; this is counterpart-topology evidence, not statistically independent measurement.

topology_trigger.declared_reopen_condition: A definitionally comparable official source provides bilateral F6, bilateral F6 components, or additional exact counterparty constraints sufficient to reduce the unconditional nullspace.

frozen_mapping.X: S2 only through explicit asset/liability orientation
forbidden: S12 may not be relabelled as RMD F.
S12 may not be split into F and BNR by residual, shares, component patterns, historical proportions or missing-to-zero assumptions.
Absence of S121 may not be interpreted as BNR=0.

reconciliation.tolerance_basis: Inherited canonical Accounting Spine/F6 accounting tolerance, frozen before Stage 2 detailed value review.
reconciliation.component_identity_check: F6 = F61+F62+F63+F64+F65+F66 where all required source rows are present.

equation_admission.aggregate_financial_sector_equations: S12 total-F6 rows may enter only as exact F+BNR sum equations.
equation_admission.component_rows_role: validation/control unless a later separately justified component-aware rank gate is required; Stage 2 direct rank expansion is based on total F6 counterpart equations.

rank_recomputation.promotion_rule: A bilateral total-F6 cell may be promoted only if its coordinate is invariant over every exact nullspace basis vector after all admitted source equations pass the value/reconciliation gate.
